## Identity and professional summary

- Full name: Juan Esteban Camargo.
- Common professional names: Juan Camargo and Juanes.
- Role: Software Engineer.
- Primary specialization: Full Stack Development.
- Location: Colombia.
- Experience: 3+ years building web platforms end-to-end.
- Education: Finishing a Systems Engineering degree at Universidad del Valle in Colombia.
- English proficiency: C2.
- Professional interests include scalable web applications, product engineering, frontend architecture, backend systems, performance optimization, technical SEO, local SEO, GEO, AEO, AI-assisted software development, and modern digital products.
- Preferred professional principle: "Make it work, make it right, make it fast."

Juan works primarily in the JavaScript/TypeScript ecosystem. His frontend experience includes React, Next.js, Vue.js, Tailwind CSS, Redux Toolkit, React Query, Pinia, Sass, Motion, Swiper, and modern component-based web development. His backend experience includes Node.js, NestJS, Prisma, PostgreSQL, API integrations, authentication, payments, dashboards, and production-oriented application architecture.

His work has involved teams and clients across multiple countries and time zones and has included healthcare, government, education, SaaS, ERP, retail/e-commerce, traffic and legal services, and business-management products.
